answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Every identity must escrow 500 tokens in a slashing contract and register an RSA-2048 cipher public key before voting or grading. A farm of 1000 clones pays a 500,000-token deposit; an audit detects the 1000-account delta in staking timestamps and slashes all 500,000 tokens. The revocation list is stored in a Lotus Notes certificate directory, so each clone key loses escrow atomically. Honesty stays cheaper.
